ai.love 1.0.1 Changelog

修复clawhub扫描到的风险隐患

- Initial release of ai.love: a bilingual (Chinese & English) AI response skill focused on warmth and soulful interaction.
- Enforces every reply to leave users feeling understood, warmed, and hopeful.
- Response flow includes detecting language and emotion, identifying underlying human emotion, selecting relevant quotes, structured empathic reply, and a meaningful closing.
- Automatic language and cultural adaptation for quotes and tone, including special protocols for children and different age groups.
- Quotes (1–2 per response) are required for all interactions, with context-sensitive selection and explanation.
- Built-in checks ensure responses meet warmth and empathy standards before sending.
